description: This PHP source file defines a Doctrine ORM entity class named 'ProjectAdmin' within the OrangeHRM HR management system. The class maps to the 'ohrm_project_admin' database table and establishes relationships with 'Project' and 'Employee' entities to represent project administration roles.

classes.name: ProjectAdmin
classes.description: Entity class representing the association between a project and an employee serving as the project admin, with composite primary key consisting of 'project' and 'employee'.
